lifecycle.entry: first executed ES trade within +/-4 ticks
termination: more-than-4-tick exit persists for one-second sealed reset interval
60 seconds without an in-vicinity executed trade
lifecycle.current_sweep: one active high/low lifecycle persists while an executed trade revises its extreme; revision supersedes the level price without creating an interaction

labels.PROBABLE_REPLENISHMENT_INTERACTION: execution causally precedes same-price displayed add
labels.ABSORPTION_INTERACTION: execution plus repeated same-price replenishment within interaction

aggressor: T remains unknown; F uses documented resting side only
future_response: first valid executed ES observation at or after horizon; signed ticks=(future ES price-reference ES price)/0.25; response sanity violations are explicit and excluded from distributions
